review.scopeLimit: This focal unit removes only the documented Web reload requirement on an Auth actor change. Historical Android/Web/iOS document creation, viewing, return and cleanup evidence remains separately authoritative.

notes: WebNeighborhoodsHost keys the complete NeighborhoodsViewModel by repository and currentUserId. A hot A to B or B to anonymous transition cannot retain the previous model state.

Main recreates WebNeighborhoodsRepository for each Auth actor and the repository owns an actor-bound cache. A delayed A callback can update only the retired A repository, never the active B or anonymous repository.

The three Chrome Headless tests prove distinct models for A, B and anonymous and prove that A attachments plus a suspended late A write remain invisible after replacing the repository with B and anonymous scopes.
DisposableEffect closes the superseded model, cancelling its profile jobs and invalidating its request generation.
No backend mutation, schema, policy, Android runtime or iOS runtime changed. The full historical document matrix was not repeated solely for this Web-only lifecycle correction.

Two exact-head reviews rejected model-only isolation and then a dynamically selected cache actor because a stale ViewModel callback could still copy A data into B. Product 792e0894 binds both repository and cache lifetime to the actor and exercises the delayed old-repository write after replacement.

The Web actor-switch delta was recomposed over main squash 204fc6ca155828088a9e5fb8b0f3117d90e62368 after #603. Product f930565da70e35ca4e7d217db26a68db4cc5119e preserves the capability matrix and four focal runtime/test blobs byte-identical to Product ee5a3f938c0030ba25777630ef877b153b6e6bd9 and historical execution Product 792e08941d1259af891354079894c9cc51d678ec; no new browser execution is attributed to the rebase.

The previous exact-head reviews returned GO with no P0-P3 and confirmed byte-identical decisive blobs, historical evidence custody and preservation of the Account documentation base. The recomposed candidate requires a fresh independent exact-head review before publication.
